item.title: Bulloch County Schools Pre-K Registration Opens Online February 21
item.description: Bulloch County Schools’ Pre-Kindergarten registration for the 2026/2027 school year opens online on Feb. 21, at 9 a.m. Visit the Pre-K website for more information and to register. The process can be completed from a computer or mobile device at home, or in-person. item.title: Chattooga Middle School Claims FCAA Basketball Championship
item.description: The Chattooga Middle School Indians are league champions. The Indians captured the Floyd County Middle School Athletic Association (FCAA) championship with a hard-fought 52-41 victory over Coosa on the Eagles’ home court. Chattooga finished the season with an impressive 13-1 record.
